automations.name: PSR submitted → notify Department Head
automations.rationale: workflow_meta.notifications step-entry → role:Department Head (ITPH-00149, BR-24 Draft→DH Review transition): 'A Project Status Report for {{Project}} ({{Reporting_Period}}) has been submitted ... awaiting your review.' IsActive:false pending step wiring.

automations.name: PSR DH-approved (sponsor required) → notify Project Sponsor
automations.rationale: BR-10 routing (health Red / baseline-or-budget change requested / PS_Approval_Required flag) + workflow_meta step-entry → role:Project Sponsor (ITPH-00157): 'A Department-Head-approved PSR ... requires your sign-off.'

automations.name: PSR returned at DH Review → notify PM with comment
automations.rationale: BR-25/ITPH-00116: DH send-back carries the platform's native mandatory-comment prompt; workflow_meta status-change → field-user:Project_Manager (ITPH-00121): 'Your PSR ... was returned by {{Returned_By}}. Reason: {{Return_Comment}}.'

automations.name: PSR returned at Sponsor Approval → notify PM with comment
automations.rationale: BR-25/ITPH-00116: Sponsor send-back is the same native mandatory-comment return, mirrored on the conditional step; same PM notification (ITPH-00121).

automations.name: PSR Approved (locked) → notify PM
automations.rationale: BR-13: reaching the terminal Approved step is a locked read-only snapshot; workflow_meta status-change → field-user:Project_Manager: 'Your PSR ... is Approved and locked.'

automations.name: PSR deadline reminders (3-day / 1-day / daily overdue)

action.condition: SLA (BR-11): PSR due on working day 5 of the following month (ITPMD Hub Settings/ITPMD Holiday Calendar working-day logic) — fire 3 days before due, 1 day before due, and daily while the Draft step remains un-submitted past due

automations.rationale: workflow_meta.slas step:itpmd_psr.Draft + workflow_meta.notifications SLA-breach → role:Project Manager (BR-11, ITPH-0097/00148/00157). Engine note: realize via the process connector's SlaBreached trigger (CONNECTOR_CATALOG.process.triggers.slaBreached) once wired — recorded here as source.event:'updated' because 'created|submitted|approved|completed|updated' is this IR's event vocabulary; the actual connector trigger selection is an engine/integrations.mjs concern, not a modeling one.

automations.name: Activity assigned/reassigned → notify Responsible Person

action.condition: Responsible_Person is set or changed (assignment or reassignment)

automations.rationale: J-03 'assignment notification automation' + workflow_meta status-change → field-user:Assignee (ITPH-00255): 'An activity or action item has been assigned to you on {{Project}}.' Reassignment history itself is native item history (D14), not this stitch.

automations.name: Activity forecast past baseline (Red) → notify Responsible Person
automations.rationale: Journey J-04 explicitly names a 'forecast-past-baseline alert automation' following the PM's forecast update; BR-03's Red threshold (variance > 10 working days, or a missed milestone) is the trigger condition.

automations.name: Action item created/assigned → notify Assignee
automations.rationale: workflow_meta status-change → field-user:Assignee (ITPH-00255): action items are assigned at creation; notify the assignee immediately.

automations.name: Action item Overdue (auto) → notify Assignee

action.condition: auto-transition In Progress/Open → Overdue when Due_Date has passed (ITPH-0037/00155)

automations.rationale: workflow_meta status:itpmd_action_item.Open/In Progress SLA on_breach: escalate + notify assignee and PM. This stitch covers the assignee half (ITPH-00155); PM visibility is reached via the same Project reference field (Project field mapped for template context), not a separate authored field.

automations.name: Issue Escalated (auto) → notify Issue Owner/PM and PSC Member

action.condition: BR-21: Priority = Critical, or Target_Resolution_Date passed the configured aging period (ITPMD Hub Settings), while still Open/In Progress

automations.rationale: BR-21 + workflow_meta status:itpmd_issue.Open/In Progress on_breach (escalate + notify PM/issue owner and role:PSC Member, ITPH-0039/0040) and BRD ITPH-00150 (PM alerts for critical issues). Issue_Owner carries the PM/delegate; PSC visibility is native board/dashboard reach for the Escalated status, not a separate authored field.

automations.name: Risk escalated (High/Critical) → notify Risk Owner
automations.rationale: BR-22 (risk escalates automatically at High/Critical rating, appears on PSC view, triggers notifications) + BRD ITPH-00150 (PM alerts for critical risks and issues). Risk is a plain Form (no workflow steps, D15/architecture), so the trigger is a field-value change (Escalation_Flag), not a step/status transition.

external_not_authored.note: Kissflow's native step-assignment / My-Items notifications and any account-level email digest for the above are delivered by the platform itself once a role/user is assigned a step or task — no separate email/SMTP automation is authored here; BRD §8.12 does not name a distinct external channel (SMS, webhook, ERP) for MVP notifications, so nothing is flagged external for this app.
